request.name: Santa Monica Fire Station No. 2
request.description: City of Santa Monica Fire Station No. 2 at 222 Hollister Ave, Ocean Park. The street front is a two-storey red brick block about 26 m wide and 8 m tall with a flat roof, a low parapet and a rooftop railing; three tall glass roll-up apparatus doors with yellow frames and yellow mullions fill the ground floor, with a brick band above carrying the lettering 'City of Santa Monica - Fire Station No. 2' in white (render the lettering band as a light strip, no real text needed); a flagpole and a small bench stand by the left door; a red curb runs along the apron. Behind the front block the lot continues as a lower yard with a rolling gate on the left. Front is +z. Metres.
